764:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

764:t_1:4.en:
$$ブルー$$
「...This is the first time we've met face to face. Allow me to introduce myself properly.」

764:t_1:5.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I am $$コード：ブルー$$. I am currently serving as acting captain of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists' action unit.」

764:t_1:7.en:
$$ブルー$$
「The members of our organization call one another by codenames.」

764:t_1:8.en:
$$ブルー$$
「With Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ gone, I now command the Reformists' operational force.」

764:t_1:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We are grateful for your cooperation in the 《$$時獄戦役$$》.」

764:t_1:10.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Not at all... As the Captain also said, the victory was possible only because of your efforts. We merely assisted.」

764:t_1:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「About two and a half months since the $$時獄戦役$$... What have you been doing in the meantime?」

764:t_1:12.en:
$$ブルー$$
「As I said at the decisive battle against $$ジェミニス$$, we have been working to take down the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, who were secretly manipulating the $$地球連邦$$, but...」

764:t_1:13.en:
$$ブルー$$
「In the chaos of the $$サイデリアル$$ invasion, we let them escape.」

764:t_1:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「So, I trust you will tell us today? Everything about $$クロノ$$.」

764:t_1:15.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I am sorry, but I cannot do that.」

764:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Why not? You said back then that you would tell us once it was all over, did you not?」

764:t_1:17.en:
$$ブルー$$
「To speak of $$クロノ$$ is to reveal its doctrine... That is the reason.」

764:t_1:18.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Doctrine... Teachings that must be kept...」

764:t_1:19.en:
$$テッサ$$
「In other words, those who keep it are the Conservatives, and you are the ones trying to change it.」

764:t_1:20.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Precisely. That is why we are not permitted to reveal it to outsiders like yourselves.」

764:t_1:21.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Only when the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives have been utterly overthrown and their doctrine has become meaningless can we bring it out into the light of day.」

764:t_1:23.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now that we understand your situation, we have no intention of forcing the issue.」

764:t_1:24.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But under that doctrine, the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives manipulated the Federation and tried to suppress the Spacenoids.」

764:t_1:25.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I also hear they were involved in the assassination of 《$$ジオン・ダイクン$$》 and that of 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》's 《$$ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword$$》.」

764:t_1:26.en:
$$オットー$$
「So $$クロノ$$ existed across parallel worlds...」

764:t_1:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Or else similar organizations existed in each of those worlds...」

764:t_1:28.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Many of those questions will be answered once the doctrine is disclosed.」

764:t_1:29.en:
$$オットー$$
「You will not tell us no matter what, then?」

764:t_1:31.en:
$$オットー$$
「...Understood. We will wait for that day.」

764:t_1:32.en:
$$オットー$$
「Dealing with the current situation is more important to us at the moment anyway.」

764:t_1:33.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I am sorry. But I assure you that we are on your side.」

764:t_1:34.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Why did you appear where we transferred to? We cannot dismiss this as coincidence.」

764:t_1:35.en:
$$ブルー$$
「If you dislike the word coincidence, how about the word destiny?」

764:t_1:37.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I was waiting in this area on orders from the upper echelons, but I had not been told that you would be coming.」

764:t_1:39.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Yes. We are only an operational force, so they are the ones who decide our actions.」

764:t_1:40.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Contacting you was also on their orders.」

764:t_1:41.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So... what exactly do you want from us?」

764:t_1:42.en:
$$ブルー$$
「At present, our greatest mission is the overthrow of the $$新地球皇国$$.」

764:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You, whose purpose is to watch over the evolution of humanity?」

764:t_1:44.en:
$$ブルー$$
「They intend to feed on our Earth... the so-called $$蒼の地球$$.」

764:t_1:45.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Extracting $$次元力$$ through the $$レイライン$$...」

764:t_1:46.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Exactly. Leaving them alone is the same as turning the Earth, our mother planet, into a dead star.」

764:t_1:47.en:
$$ブルー$$
「We cannot hand over to them the Earth that Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ staked his life to protect.」

764:t_1:49.en:
$$オットー$$
「But the fact is, $$サイデリアル$$'s power is overwhelming. With the chain of command in disarray and the $$連邦軍$$ even more worn down, defeating them would be far too difficult.」

764:t_1:50.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$c is also forced to disperse its forces, so it cannot aim for a single-point breakthrough either.」

764:t_1:51.en:
$$ブルー$$
「If the strength of $$蒼の地球$$ alone is no match for them, why not seek strength elsewhere?」

764:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ブルー$$... Do you know the situation on that planet?」

764:t_1:55.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Yes... We have already descended to $$翠の地球$$ several times.」

764:t_1:56.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「With $$サイデリアル$$ holding control of space, that you could do such a thing...」

764:t_1:57.en:
$$ブルー$$
「...No. We went to $$翠の地球$$ back during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

764:t_1:59.en:
$$オットー$$
「You broke through the $$時の牢獄$$!?」

764:t_1:60.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Only under limited conditions, but the power of Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s $$アスクレプス$$ made it possible.」

764:t_1:61.en:
$$オットー$$
「To think that such a thing had happened...」

764:t_1:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
(A machine different even from the $$スフィア$$-equipped units... Just how much power did it have...)

764:t_1:63.en:
$$ブルー$$
「As you know, $$サイデリアル$$ invaded $$蒼の地球$$ using $$翠の地球$$ as a forward base.」

764:t_1:64.en:
$$ブルー$$
「And on $$翠の地球$$, too, a force resisting $$サイデリアル$$, just like yours, is still fighting today.」

764:t_1:65.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So we would form a joint front with them...」

764:t_1:66.en:
$$ブルー$$
「$$サイデリアル$$'s main force is moving from $$翠の地球$$ to $$蒼の地球$$.」

764:t_1:67.en:
$$ブルー$$
「If your strength joins the local forces, liberating $$翠の地球$$ should be possible.」

764:t_1:68.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And after that, we ask them for help to retake $$蒼の地球$$...」

764:t_1:69.en:
$$ブルー$$
「On $$翠の地球$$, I was acting together with people who know you.」

764:t_1:71.en:
$$ブルー$$
「$$セツコ・オハラ$$, $$ランド・トラビス$$, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$...」

764:t_1:72.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So they were on $$翠の地球$$.」

764:t_1:73.en:
$$オットー$$
「Those three are, if I remember right...」

764:t_1:74.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. They are the 《$$スフィア・リアクター$$》 who fought in $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

764:t_1:75.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If we can join up with them, they will be a great force.」

764:t_1:77.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But if we head for $$翠の地球$$, the front on $$蒼の地球$$ will be that much thinner.」

764:t_1:78.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I propose we handle this by splitting our forces in two.」

764:t_1:79.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will stay on $$蒼の地球$$. I also have to report the situation to Commander $$ブライト$$.」

764:t_1:80.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「In that case, the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ and the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will head for $$翠の地球$$.」

764:t_1:81.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The force going to $$翠の地球$$ will be formed from $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ and $$ミスリル$$, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$, and the $$マジンガーチーム$$.」

764:t_1:82.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then the force staying on $$蒼の地球$$ will be formed from mobile suits.」

マジンガーチーム.evidence: Group of Mazinger pilots; not in glossary sheet. Jeffrey lists it as a unit joining the Green Earth force.
